fib: ______ is the number of people with specific characteristics divided by the total number of people or the number of times and event did occur compared with the number of time it could have occurred.
Rate
Rate is the number of people with specific characteristics divided by the total number of people or the number of times and event did occur compared with the number of time it could have occurred.
______ is the comparison of one thing to another.
Ratio
Ratio is the comparison of one thing to another.
______ is the application of statistical principles to analyze and describe the vital events of life; birth, death, morbidity risk, etc.
Vital statistics
Vital statistics is the application of statistical principles to analyze and describe the vital events of life; birth, death, morbidity risk, etc.
______ are used only to make categories distinct. iii.
numbers
The numbers are used only to make categories distinct. iii.
______ is the ability of a person to live a life socially and economically acceptable to self and others at a particular period and within the context of one's environment and genetic make-up.
Health
Health is the ability of a person to live a life socially and economically acceptable to self and others at a particular period and within the context of one's environment and genetic make-up.
______ is an important indicator of living standard.
mortality
Mortality especially infant mortality is an important indicator of living standard.
______ is the extent to which values in a distribution differ from the average of the distribution.
Measure of dispersion
Measure of dispersion is the extent to which values in a distribution differ from the average of the distribution.
______ is the number of deaths attributed to a specific cause.
numerator
The numerator is the number of deaths attributed to a specific cause.
______ is the entire entity that may consist of sub-set of entities, units, sub-groups one is interested in while screening, surveying or conducting research.
Population
Population is the entire entity that may consist of sub-set of entities, units, sub-groups one is interested in while screening, surveying or conducting research.
______ is the lack of information on temporally of disease state and exposures.
principal disadvantage
The principal disadvantage is the lack of information on temporally of disease state and exposures.
